about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - Pathfinder Flip-Mat: Deadly Mines Multi-Pack


Not all mines are filled with opportunities for wealth--some contain even greater opportunities for 
danger !




The 
Pathfinder Flip-Mat: Deadly Mine Multi-Pack  features two maps that combine to form a massive sprawling mine complex. This line of gaming maps provides ready-to-use and captivatingly detailed fantasy set pieces for the busy Game Master. The next time your players are ready to explore a long-lost mine, this map has you covered!


NOTE:  This product has been made specifically for the Pathfinder 2.0 ruleset, but can be used for Pathfinder, 5E, Starfinder, Starfinder 2.0 or any ruleset supported by Fantasy Grounds

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and Features the Following additions:



<ul> <li> All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage</li>
<li> All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them</li>
</ul>"
